dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible but low-contrast pale fringes on the margins of the primary flight feathers against a dark slate-gray background.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: An elliptical, high-contrast yellowish-buff patch centered on the crown and extending towards the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A sharp, distinct linear boundary separating the yellowish-buff head patch from the dark gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct yellow-buff crown patch contrasting sharply with the uniform dark gray-blue plumage of the rest of the upperparts.
